checklist.title: What the Best Dryclean Should Offer — and How Wash4You Does It
checklist.subtitle: “Best” is easy to claim. These are the six things worth checking before you hand over a suit or a silk saree, and exactly what Wash4You does for each.

items.title: Real dryclean machines
items.check: Is it actually drycleaned, or washed in a home-style machine?
items.answer: Wash4You drycleans on commercial machines with fabric-safe, biodegradable solvents, and steam-finishes every piece by hand.

items.title: Counted at your door
items.check: Do you get a count and a receipt when your clothes leave?
items.answer: Every piece is counted in front of you at pickup and logged on an itemised receipt.

items.title: Stains treated first
items.check: Are stains assessed before cleaning, or after it is too late?
items.answer: Marks are identified and pre-treated before the main clean, and we tell you honestly when a stain may not lift completely.

items.title: Published prices
items.check: Can you see the price before you book?
items.answer: Every item on the price list has a published starting rate — no quote-on-request for everyday clothes.

items.title: Your order kept separate
items.check: Is your order mixed with other customers' clothes?
items.answer: Each order is bagged, tagged and handled on its own from pickup to delivery.

items.title: Free pickup & delivery
items.check: Do you have to find parking and queue at a counter?
items.answer: Pickup and delivery are free across Gurugram, Delhi, Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad.
